summary: 5C Lending Partners Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a September 2, 2026 second amendment to its Loan, Security and Collateral Management Agreement with Ally Bank as administrative agent, U.S. Bank as collateral custodian, and 5CLP BDC I ABL SPV-A LLC as borrower. The amendment raises the revolving ABL facility by $200 million to $600 million, lifts the swingline commitment to $60 million, revises excess concentration limits, and increases spreads to 1.83% over Benchmark and 0.83% over Base Rate. This is a routine credit-facility upsize, not a special situation.
